tagline: Egypt's Mediterranean capital — a Corniche sea line above chronic seafront traffic.
summary: Alexandria is Egypt's second city and principal Mediterranean seaport, a dense urban coast wrapped around the historic Eastern Harbour beneath the Qaitbay Citadel. Its long Corniche suffers chronic seafront congestion, and local pleasure craft already work the harbour. A sea line along the Corniche — from the Eastern Harbour to the Montaza gardens — offers a scenic premium tier above the traffic. There is no regulated scheduled passenger series today, so this is a display + rich-brief market with null economics until a series is found.

navier_fit.pioneer_ii: Pioneer II covers the Corniche run (~9 nm) and harbour hops comfortably.
navier_fit.quanta_lr: Quanta-LR (H2 2026+) is optional here; the core network is well inside Pioneer II all-electric range.

competitive_landscape: Local pleasure craft work the harbour; there is no scheduled premium passenger tier. The pain is Corniche road congestion.
seasonality: Mediterranean summer (Jun–Sep) is peak; winter storms are a constraint. The Eastern Harbour is a sheltered crescent.
regulatory_note: Egyptian jurisdiction: the Alexandria Port Authority and the maritime authority. Clean-fleet operation suits a dense urban seafront.
